title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4AGRI - MovementActivitySensor
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4agri/MovementActivitySensor. A class to describe a motion sensor. Subclass of saref:Sensor (SAREF core class, not modeled here); inherited saref:Sensor vocabulary is documented here rather than repeated structurally, per the Gaia-X inheritance-flattening precedent. NOTE: the SAREF4AGRI v2.1.1 ontology does not declare a dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for 'movement'/'activity level' (unlike Precipitation, SoilMoisture, etc.); 'observes' is therefore left as free text rather than constrained to the ten declared named individuals. NOTE: the official dataModel.Agrifood subject publishes a conceptually related but differently-named 'AnimalMovement' entity.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MovementActivitySensor'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

observes.description: Property/Relationship. saref:observes. A free-text label for the quantity observed (e.g. 'MovementActivity'), since v2.1.1 declares no dedicated saref4agri:Property named individual for motion/activity level.

hasFeatureOfInterest.description: Relationship. saref:hasFeatureOfInterest. The Animal (or AnimalGroup) this measurement is about.

value.description: Property. saref:hasValue. The last activity-level measurement reported by the sensor (e.g. a motion/step count).

unitCode.description: Property. saref:isMeasuredIn. The unit of measure for 'value' (e.g. 'counts/h').

dateObserved.description: Property. The date and time this measurement was made.
